localizedDescriptions.en: Discover and use the actions available in apps linked to Composio Connect.
localizedDescriptions.zh-CN: 通过 Composio Connect 查找并使用已连接应用的操作。

en: List the apps already connected to my Composio account and summarize what each one can do.
zh-CN: 列出已连接到我 Composio 账号的应用，并总结每个应用可用的操作。

instructions.en: In Composio For You, open Settings → Sessions & API Key. Copy the Connect consumer key beginning with ck_ into the plugin settings.
instructions.zh-CN: 在 Composio For You 的「设置 → Sessions & API Key」中复制以 ck_ 开头的 Connect 用户密钥，再填入插件设置。
